title: Stop waiting for permission to walk in your calling. You won’t get it.
paragraphs: Stop waiting for permission to walk in your calling. You won’t get it.
The loneliest chapter of your life is often the one right before your biggest breakthrough.
When you are down, they make excuses. When you rise up, they make accusations. The sad truth is, some people would rather see you struggle with them than succeed without them.
Don’t let their silence stop you or their hate distract you. Your assignment was never dependent on their approval. If you have to fly alone, fly anyway.
⚔️ The Word: "Have I not commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged, for the Lord your God will be with you wherever you go." — Joshua 1:9
